fee_notes: Fee varies by number of territories purchased: 1 territory = $60,000; 2 = $110,000; 3 = $145,000; 4 = $170,000; 5 = $190,000; each additional contiguous territory after the 5th = $20,000 each. Fee is non-refundable and due at signing. Veterans (VetFran members) receive a $1,000 discount regardless of territories purchased. During the last fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, Initial Franchise Fees collected ranged from $20,616 to $134,925.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee you pay will depend on the number of Territories you qualify for and elect to purchase, as approved by us. The Initial Franchise Fee structure is set forth in the following table: One (1) Territory $60,000 / Two (2) Territories $110,000 / Three (3) Territories $145,000 / Four (4) Territories $170,000 / Five (5) Territories $190,000 / Each additional contiguous Territory after the purchase of the fifth (5th) Territory $20,000 for each additional contiguous Territory. We are a member of the VetFran program. If you are a veteran of the United States Armed Services, your Initial Franchise Fee will be discounted by $1,000 total, regardless of the number of Territories you purchase. During our last fiscal year, which ended September 30, 2025, we collected Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $20,616 to $134,925.
